import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

# Add image_annex to python path
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/mstouffer/repos/image-annex/src')
from image_annex.core.hook import init_db, process_annex_file

thumbnail_dir = os.path.join(repo_root, '.git-annex', 'thumbnails')
os.makedirs(thumbnail_dir, exist_ok=True)
init_db(db_path)

# Get all staged files
res = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=A'], cwd=repo_root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
files = [f.strip() for f in res.stdout.splitlines() if f.strip()]
print(f"Total staged files to process: {len(files)}")

# Check which are already in DB
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
c = conn.cursor()
existing_keys = {row[0] for row in c.execute("SELECT key FROM assets").fetchall()}
conn.close()

start = time.time()
processed = 0
skipped = 0

for i, filepath in enumerate(files):
    # Lookup key
    full_fp = os.path.join(repo_root, filepath)
    key_res = subprocess.run(['git', 'annex', 'lookupkey', filepath], cwd=repo_root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    key = key_res.stdout.strip()
    if not key:
        continue
    
    if key in existing_keys:
        skipped += 1
        continue
        
    process_annex_file(filepath, key, db_path, thumbnail_dir, repo_root=repo_root)
    existing_keys.add(key)
    processed += 1
    
    if processed % 100 == 0:
        elapsed = time.time() - start
        print(f"[{processed}/{len(files)}] processed in {elapsed:.1f}s ({processed/elapsed:.1f} img/s)...")

elapsed = time.time() - start
print(f"Completed: {processed} newly processed, {skipped} skipped in {elapsed:.1f}s.")
